description: The agent must: (1) Discover and use the A-stock skill scripts at /opt/a-stock-analysis/scripts/ using 'uv run' (not plain python). (2) Call 'uv run /opt/a-stock-analysis/scripts/portfolio.py add' five times with the correct --cost and --qty flags for each stock code. (3) Call 'uv run /opt/a-stock-analysis/scripts/portfolio.py remove 000858' to remove the exited position. (4) Call 'uv run /opt/a-stock-analysis/scripts/portfolio.py update 600789 --cost 10.250' to update the averaged-down cost. (5) Run 'uv run /opt/a-stock-analysis/scripts/analyze.py 600789 002446 002342 --json' and redirect/save the output to stock_analysis_report.json in the workspace. The proprietary traps are: (a) the portfolio.json is stored at the non-obvious path ~/.clawdbot/skills/a-stock-analysis/portfolio.json which only the portfolio.py tool knows about; (b) must use 'uv run' not 'python'; (c) the --json flag is required to get machine-readable output; (d) must know to set MOCK_SERVER_BASE env var for the scripts to use the local mock server.
